name: GORY TOTEM
text: Set up before the battle wholly within your territory, more than 2 inches from every other marker. While an enemy within 3 inches of it shoots, fights or retaliates, its attack dice cannot be re-rolled.

name: BLOODY CADAVER
text: Set up like the Gory Totem. Only friendly Goremongers can pick the marker up. In each Ready step you may raise the gore tank of one friendly Goremonger that controls it and is not in an enemy control range.

name: CHAOS SIGIL
text: Once per turning point, when an operative shoots a friendly Goremonger, at the start of the Roll Defence Dice step: until the end of that sequence the weapon's Piercing x is 1 lower (Piercing 1 is ignored).

name: WRIST CHAINS
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Goremonger Shoots and picks a ranged weapon, its chainblade, chainglaive, great chainaxe (without Brutal) and pickrippers count as ranged weapons with Range 2 inches until the end of that action. Balanced or Relentless from Enhanced Violence stays on them.
